reason: I already paid for salon software once and my staff never touched it, so it got cancelled. The money is not the issue. The issue is that on a busy Sunday my stylists will not stop to type numbers into a phone, and then I am paying ₹500 a month for an app nobody uses.
objection: My staff are busy with customers and they won't type everything into an app. The cash-drawer check and the live chair view only work if every bill goes in, and I know from last time that it won't happen.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial of one month where you come back after two weeks and show me my staff actually billed most walk-ins through it, with no upfront fee until it is proven.
